# AutoGeneratedCampaignSettings

**Level:** `subsection` · **Family:** [ShoppingCartConfig](../ontology/families.md#shoppingcartconfig) (domain `Service`)

**Ontology:** [AutoGeneratedCampaignSettings in Part 1](../ontology/AutoGeneratedCampaignSettings.md)

Configuration for the auto-generated Campaign DataObject. Controls which features are available for campaigns.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Allowed values | Details | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `supportBudgetLimits` | `Boolean` | no | `false` |  |  | NOT IMPLEMENTED: no runtime reads this flag and no budget counter exists, so it caps nothing; true is reported as the validation warning SHOPPING_CART_CAMPAIGN_LIMIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. |
| `supportUsageLimits` | `Boolean` | no | `false` |  |  | Whether campaigns can have usage limits (max total redemptions). When true: every cart-router checkout records promotion usage - inside the checkout claim, the usageCount column of each campaign the checkout used (its reward campaigns and the coupon campaigns of the cart's codes) is incremented once - and a campaign rule { ruleType: 'usageLimit', config: { maxUses: n } } is enforced: coupon evaluation refuses the campaign once usageCount reaches n (COUPON_NOT_ELIGIBLE), and the checkout increment is guarded in the database (usageCount + 1 <= n), so two checkouts racing for the last use cannot both win - the loser is refused 409 PROMOTION_USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED with its cart unchanged and retryable. A definite order-create failure gives the use back. When false: nothing is recorded by the cart router, and a usageLimit rule fails with USAGE_LIMITS_DISABLED. A CartCheckoutAction records usage per its own recordPromotionUsage option either way. |
| `supportCustomerLimits` | `Boolean` | no | `false` |  |  | NOT IMPLEMENTED: no runtime reads this flag and no per-customer counter exists, so it caps nothing; true is reported as the validation warning SHOPPING_CART_CAMPAIGN_LIMIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. The implemented cap is the total one: supportUsageLimits with a usageLimit rule. |
| `supportDailyLimits` | `Boolean` | no | `false` |  |  | NOT IMPLEMENTED: no runtime reads this flag and no daily counter exists, so it caps nothing; true is reported as the validation warning SHOPPING_CART_CAMPAIGN_LIMIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. |
| `supportScheduling` | `Boolean` | no | `false` |  |  | Informational: the dateRange and timeOfDay campaign rules are evaluated whether or not this flag is set; no runtime reads it. |
| `supportCustomerTags` | `Boolean` | no | `false` |  |  | Informational: no runtime reads this flag. The customerTag campaign rule has no built-in evaluator; register one with registerRule('customerTag', ...). |

## Constraints

No rule beyond the property types is attributed to this pattern. See [Constraints coverage](./constraints.md) for what this block covers.

## Migration

> **Warning:** deprecated and relocated properties. They are listed so that older blueprints can be updated; new blueprints must not use them.

| Property | Status | Use instead | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `generateAdminApis` | deprecated | | RETIRED: no template in any language has ever read this flag, so the campaign/coupon admin CRUD APIs it advertised were never emitted — in nodejs, java, python, rust, golang, dotnet or php. It is kept only so stored blueprints that carry it stay valid; do not set it. To administer campaigns and coupons, author ordinary BusinessApis against the campaign/coupon data objects. The coupon RUNTIME surface is unaffected and is not gated by this flag: the cart router's POST /<cart>/coupons and DELETE /<cart>/coupons/:code are emitted from promotionSettings.dynamicPromotions.supportCoupons. |
